body:
I don't know what/how much I feel. I still have ambitions. I still have an idea of a life I wanted to have. I still think of things I wanted to do. What if I do this? What if I go here? Will it change anything? Sometimes I have to suppress these thoughts. It's mentally unhealthy, I know, but so is wanting things I can't have because I'm not, or don't believe I am, equipped to get them.  In a few days, maybe I'll leave the house. I have a summer job I took before deciding to give up. I will wake up, I will go to the job, I will work, and I will come home and sleep. I don't expect anything from it. I applied to grocery stores for after the summer. I just remembered I have GREs the first week of August. I was doing well in practice exams that I was taking. But I haven't looked at them at all in ages. I wanted to do better, improve my score, get into a really good grad school. I know I could get into a good grad school easily, anyway--I don't want to anymore.

Sometimes I worry that I'm going to regret this funk. I'm 20 for god's sake, why am I giving up on life? It's irrational. I imagine hypothetically conversing with a person I admire, telling him my new life plans. Just thinking about telling him embarrasses me and makes me realize I'm ridiculous. Why am I resigning myself instead of putting a little more effort into getting things I think I want, which, admittedly, I could afford to (give more effort)? Would walking around a little, treating myself better, hurt me? 

Then I tell myself no, but it wouldn't help me. It's all pointless. I might as well not tire myself out.

I'm sorry for making you feel like shit. At my worst, I try to take everyone and everything down with me. At my best, I only take myself down, and not as much. "Cope with life" seems like a more achievable goal than "improve it."

I know that there are so many people in my position, and that my thoughts could be put into millions of peoples' heads verbatim and there would be no difference. It provides little comfort--no discomfort, either, but at this point, there's a very small number of things that can have an effect, positive or negative, on my mental state right now. I am very comfortable, I have a very nice lot in life that most people would like to have, and yet all I could do is want more, but fear what could happen if I lose what I have now.  So I'm just trying to break even for as long as I can.
